selector.rationale: The patient's symptoms and imaging results, including a sellar/suprasellar mass compressing the optic chiasm and homogeneous enhancement after contrast administration, are most consistent with a pituitary adenoma. The endocrinological evaluation also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Craniopharyngioma
rejected.why: Lack of specific findings such as calcifications or cystic components

rejected.label: Meningioma
rejected.why: Typically has a dural tail and is less likely to be primarily suprasellar

rejected.label: Lymphocytic hypophysitis
rejected.why: Usually presents with more acute symptoms and pituitary inflammation
